topic: Achilles pain: will rest fix it?
caption:
Stiff Achilles every morning? 🦶
Achilles pain often responds better to progressive strengthening than rest alone.

⚠️ A sudden 'snap' with difficulty walking needs prompt medical care.

📍 Chatswood · Sydney CBD
